title: Audition form: judge and play candidate layers as a 16-bar audition (scene 4, new part solo 4, both with a quick build 8), not a full track
description: User request (2026-09-27): full 40-bar candidates take too long to review and use too much disk. Standard audition, 16 bars (32 s at 120 BPM): bars 1-4 the existing scene alone; 5-8 the new part solo; 9-16 both, a quick 2-bar build then 6 bars together. Score candidates on the together window with the baseline over the same window (fixes the windowed-vs-full-song guard mismatch). Recorded in the write-score skill (references/recipes.md, 'Auditioning a layer'). Build: analysis/apricity_analyze/audition_form.py + scripts/audition-form.py (render the candidate score --bars W with --stems, scene = stems minus the candidate, solo = the candidate stem, together = mix with the candidate ramped in over 2 bars; loudness-normalize; write .m4a; delete wavs/stems). Use it in the optimizer's L1/L2 and cycle folders and in the explorer, and make the explorer delete renders after scoring (apricitus-ae80d4).
